terminals.name: wrangler-dev
terminals.command: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false npx wrangler d1 execute repl-demo-2025-d1 --local --file=schemas/photos.sql && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false npx wrangler dev --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787
terminals.description: Applies the local D1 schema (idempotent) then runs the Cloudflare Workers dev server (Miniflare) with local D1, R2, KV, and Workflows bindings at http://localhost:8787.
